summary: South Park: The Stick of Truth is a 2014 role-playing video game developed by Obsidian Entertainment with South Park Digital Studios and published by Ubisoft. It is based on the animated series South Park and follows the New Kid, who joins an epic fantasy role-play war over the all-powerful Stick of Truth. The game escalates into conflicts with aliens, Nazi zombies, and gnomes that threaten the whole town.
one_line: A 2014 South Park role-playing video game by Obsidian Entertainment and Ubisoft about a fantasy war over the Stick of Truth.
key_facts: South Park: The Stick of Truth is a 2014 role-playing video game.
The game was developed by Obsidian Entertainment in collaboration with South Park Digital Studios.
The game was published by Ubisoft.
The game is based on the American adult animated television series South Park.
The game's protagonist is the New Kid, who has moved to the town of South Park.
The New Kid becomes involved in an epic role-play fantasy war.
The war involves humans, wizards, and elves fighting for control of the all-powerful Stick of Truth.
The role-play game quickly escalates out of control.
The game brings the player into conflict with aliens, Nazi zombies, and gnomes.
The conflicts threaten the entire town with destruction.
